protocol.title: Expansion of Patient-Derived Circulating Tumor Cells from Liquid Biopsies Using a CTC Microfluidic Culture Device
protocol.platform: Three-layer PDMS microfluidic device (gradient generator / barrier layer / microwell array); soft lithography + diffuser back-side lithography
cell_lines: MCF-7 (human breast cancer, ATCC HTB-22) - device characterisation and spheroid validation
MDA-MB-231 (human breast cancer, ATCC CRM-HTB-26) - device characterisation
Patient blood samples - clinical CTC cluster formation and drug screening
protocol.objective: Ex vivo expansion of patient-derived CTCs from liquid biopsies into CTC clusters without prior enrichment or growth factor supplements; downstream drug screening and immunofluorescence characterisation

layers: Layer i: Concentration gradient generator (uppermost) - PDMS replica on silicon wafer / SU-8 master; tree-like branched channels; 2 inlets, 8 outputs
Layer ii: Barrier layer (middle) - PDMS soft replica of aluminum mold (machined); compartmentalises 8 gradient outputs into individual culture lanes
Layer iii: Microwell layer (bottom) - PDMS by diffuser back-side lithography; inverted dome-shaped elliptical microwells

material.name: PDMS (Sylgard 184, Dow Corning)
material.bonding: Oxygen plasma treatment (150 W, 0.05 torr, 90 s) + bake at 80 C >=1 h

gradient_calibration.dye: FITC (fluorescein isothiocyanate isomer I, Sigma F7250)
gradient_calibration.reader: Tecan Infinite M200 PRO fluorescence plate reader

surfactant_coatings.pluronic_acid: Pluronics F-127 or Pluronic acid (Sigma 9003-11-6) in PBS; 0.1% vol/vol
surfactant_coatings.purpose: Promote spheroid formation with cancer cell lines; not required for clinical samples

post_enrichment.purpose: Negative selection of CD45+ leukocytes for higher-purity CTC fraction
post_enrichment.use_case: Required for genomic sequencing; optional for drug screening

steps.name: Device priming with ethanol
steps.notes: Two syringes of 70% ethanol on separate syringe pumps; removes air bubbles from gradient generator. Priming ends when no air bubbles remain in channels.

steps.name: PBS flush to remove ethanol
steps.notes: Remove all ethanol residue from gradient generator before cell culture. Replace syringes by disconnecting from tips (not tubing) to prevent new air bubbles.

steps.name: Gradient generator calibration - 25 uL/min
steps.notes: 100 uM FITC dye vs DI water. Collect 60 uL from each of 8 channels after 30 min equilibration. Dispose gradient mix and calibration signal.

steps.name: Gradient generator calibration - 50 uL/min
steps.notes: Identical to S3 at 50 uL/min.

steps.name: Gradient generator calibration - 100 uL/min
steps.notes: Also run separately with 20 uM FITC (Step 67) to confirm concentration-independence.

steps.name: Gradient generator calibration - 150 uL/min
steps.notes: Identical to S3 at 150 uL/min.

steps.name: Gradient generator calibration - 200 uL/min
steps.notes: Final flow rate run. After all five calibration runs, flush device with PBS to clear FITC. Repeat entire calibration on 3 independent devices (Step 68).

steps.name: RBC lysis
steps.notes: RBC lysis buffer is hypotonic; promotes hemolysis by osmotic stress. Both blood and buffer at room temperature before mixing. Do not exceed 5 min lysis. Process within 6 h of blood draw.

steps.name: Nucleated cell wash
steps.notes: Resuspend pellet in 5 mL PBS to remove residual RBC debris. Repeat wash if debris remains (red layer above white/yellowish pellet after centrifugation).

steps.name: Cell resuspension in supplemented DMEM
steps.notes: Volume-based seeding because initial CTC count does not predict cluster-forming potential. Use multichannel pipette for simultaneous seeding across all channels.

steps.name: Cell seeding into microwell device - Day 0 to Day 3
steps.notes: No surfactant coating required for clinical samples; non-adherent blood cells cushion CTCs. Multichannel pipette seeding into 8 channels. Day 0 of culture.

steps.name: Day-3 partial media change and Day 3 to Day 14 culture
steps.operation: drain then mix (partial media removal and replacement) then heat
steps.notes: Minimal disturbance critical to prevent cell loss. Increase media change frequency if media turns yellow before 72 h (highly proliferative culture).

cluster_criteria.morphological: Multilayered cell aggregate with defined boundaries
cluster_criteria.cell_density: Low grayscale values in ImageJ histogram of microwell region

steps.name: Post-enrichment with anti-CD45 microbeads (optional)
steps.notes: Optional. Mix cluster harvest with anti-CD45 microbeads per manufacturer protocol (Miltenyi Biotec). Drain depletes CD45+ leukocytes. Not gated separately in CFG; integrated into BB4 (clusterJoin) before drug screening.

steps.name: Drug exposure - doxorubicin gradient
steps.delivery: Gradient generator 8-point dilution series; syringe pump or hand pipette
steps.notes: Freshly prepare drug solution and store on ice. Gradient generator delivers drug vs. vehicle control across all 8 channels simultaneously.

steps.name: Drug efficacy viability staining and detection
steps.read_out: Cell viability (%) vs. drug concentration (%); IC50 curve

steps.name: Cluster harvest by trypsinisation
steps.operation: mix then heat then mix then drain then mix
steps.notes: Wash with 1 mL PBS. Add 1 mL trypsin; incubate 37 C 3 min. Neutralise with equal volume fresh DMEM. Dissociate by gentle pipetting. Centrifuge 335g, 3 min; resuspend in 1 mL PBS.

steps.name: PFA fixation
steps.operation: mix then heat (on-ice incubation at 4 C)
steps.notes: 4% wt/vol PFA; 10 min on ice. Alternatively, stain CD45 before fixation to prevent loss of membrane antigens.

steps.name: BSA blocking
steps.operation: mix then heat (on-ice incubation at 4 C)
steps.notes: 2.5% wt/vol BSA in PBS; 30 min on ice.

steps.name: Triton X-100 permeabilisation
steps.operation: mix then heat (on-ice incubation at 4 C)
steps.notes: 0.1% vol/vol Triton X-100; 1 min on ice. Enables intracellular antibody penetration (pan-CK).

steps.name: PBS wash after permeabilisation
steps.notes: Wash with PBS; centrifuge 335g, 3 min. Remove Triton X-100 before antibody staining.

steps.name: Primary antibody and nuclear stain incubation
steps.operation: mix then heat (on-ice incubation at 4 C)
steps.notes: pan-CK (FITC, 1:50) + CD45 (APC, 1:50) + Hoechst (1:1000). Protect from light to prevent fluorophore bleaching.

steps.name: Final PBS wash and resuspension for imaging

culture_conditions.cluster_composition: Heterogeneous co-culture; 10-50% epithelial CK+ cancer cells of total cell count
culture_conditions.key_mechanism: Patient WBCs act as feeder cells; monocytes differentiate into tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) within clusters, mimicking tumor microenvironment

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Device priming, gradient calibration, blood prep, seeding, culture, drug screen, harvest, immunostaining

omissions: Photolithography and soft-lithography device fabrication (Steps 1-52): no BioScript fluid primitive equivalent
DNA/RNA FISH procedure (Steps 87-99): no BioScript fluid primitive equivalent
bioscript_compiler_notes.scoping_note: All QC-gated variables (clusterSignal, drugSignal, stainingSignal) defined at BB1/main scope. Inner if/else blocks limited to dispose/drain of same-block droplets only.
bioscript_compiler_notes.drain_note: BioScript `drain` compiles to `dispose(...)` in IR. Source-level distinction preserved for human readability only.

ir_observations.seededDevice_after_drain: seededDevice1[0] is used in mix after drain; BioScript SSA does not enforce consumed semantics after drain. Physically correct: cells remain in device after partial media removal.
